scope: Public iOS and web; excludes internal WolfGridSales
method: Official public product and help documentation. No paid-account hands-on testing. Documented capabilities are vendor statements, not independent effectiveness evidence.

requirements.salesrabbit: Mapped leads, status filters, notes, reminders, appointments.
requirements.spotio: Map/list records, visit activities, configurable visit outcomes.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: Public campaigns, CRM, sessions; full comparable-flow testing pending.

requirements.salesrabbit: Area assignment and rep location paths.
requirements.spotio: Territory hierarchy, assignment, GPS trails, team location.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: Routes and live sessions exist; hierarchical access and historical GPS audit need comparison.

requirements.salesrabbit: Mobile route planning.
requirements.spotio: Assign, reorder, optimize, lasso stops, start/end points, saved and scheduled routes.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: app/api/routes and campaign route optimization; recurring and scheduled-route parity unverified.

requirements.salesrabbit: Mobile support; exact offline guarantees not established by these sources.
requirements.spotio: Area downloads valid 24 hours, queued activities and new records, retry/history and later geocoding.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: Sales currently requires connectivity; existing map caching is not an offline sale outbox.

requirements.salesrabbit: Custom fields, attachments, forms, locked leads.
requirements.spotio: Multiple parent/child objects, typed fields and configurable stages; fields can be required by stage.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: Public customer stages, private opportunities, weighted estimates and follow-up tasks are implemented. Flexible object relationships and arbitrary fields remain gaps.

requirements.salesrabbit: Feature matrix does not establish WolfGrid-style financial review rules.
requirements.spotio: Reporting on stage and deal activity; exact owner self-verification policy not established.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: Lead-linked pending/verified/cancelled records, retry safety, immutable verified attribution and cancellation history.

requirements.salesrabbit: Dashboards, reports, TV views and social feed.
requirements.spotio: Custom MyReports and report-derived leaderboards with private/team/territory/role visibility.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: Verified Sales/Revenue ranks, historical periods, auditable reviews and CSV of displayed records. No general report builder or scheduled delivery.

requirements.salesrabbit: Shared appointment scheduling for field sales.
requirements.spotio: Dedicated setter/closer report configuration.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: One attributed rep and optional appointment; separate setter/closer attribution remains to implement.

requirements.salesrabbit: Appointment scheduling and calendar integration.
requirements.spotio: Calendar activities and routes built from scheduled activities.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: Calendar and appointment screens exist; live two-way calendar sync and setter availability need verification.

requirements.salesrabbit: Do not infer SPOTIO-style automation from the reviewed Core matrix.
requirements.spotio: Manual email/text/call/custom steps plus automatic email and text; intervals, business hours, timezone, throttles, templates, pause/clone/archive and analytics.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: Existing reminders are not a versioned enrollment and delivery engine. Provider delivery, suppression and retries must be validated.

requirements.salesrabbit: Platform integrations vary; native equivalent not established here.
requirements.spotio: In-app inbound/outbound calling.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: Public contact outbound and telecom routes exist; do not count internal WolfGridSales dialler as public parity.

requirements.salesrabbit: Integration-dependent capabilities.
requirements.spotio: Integrated texting and communication templates.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: Public contact communications routes require authenticated provider acceptance; no sales sequence engine yet.

requirements.salesrabbit: Form builder, mobile signatures and electronic processing; Core add-on.
requirements.spotio: Templates, in-person or email signatures, one/two signers, completed-file storage; Dropbox Sign delivery.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: No verified public contract lifecycle. Requires provider credentials, approved templates and signature audit/completion handling.

requirements.salesrabbit: DataGrid AI buyer scoring and homeowner/business data.
requirements.spotio: Provider-backed household/property filters, saved criteria, monthly refresh, map-to-lead creation.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: Territory IQ exists but is not equivalent to licensed person/household datasets or trained buyer propensity.

requirements.salesrabbit: New-homeowner lead offering.
requirements.spotio: Lead Machine includes recent-buyer and purchase-date criteria.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: No verified mover feed entitlement or recurring refresh contract.

requirements.salesrabbit: Storm overlays and weather reports.
requirements.spotio: Relevant integrations appear in product ecosystem; direct equivalent not established here.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: StormMaps providers/tiles exist; licensed coverage and historical report equivalence require validation.

requirements.salesrabbit: Competitions, rewards store, battles, achievements, experience/levels and scorecards.
requirements.spotio: Custom ranking metrics and shared leaderboards; do not assume native reward-store parity.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: Existing challenges/Wolfy work; cancellation-safe verified-sales rewards and contests need separate acceptance.

requirements.salesrabbit: DataGrid intelligence focuses on targeting.
requirements.spotio: DASH IQ: company knowledge, record search and summaries. Actions: confirmed record/activity changes, multi-step work, photo extraction and message drafts. Go and Connect are additional pillars.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: Deterministic Sales coaching exists. Concurrent Wolfy work must be assessed separately; no claim of full DASH equivalence.

requirements.salesrabbit: Marketplace, API/webhooks and third-party connectors; availability differs in Core/+ builds.
requirements.spotio: Salesforce native two-way sync, HubSpot/Zapier connectors and webhooks.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: Several public CRM providers exist; sale synchronization, field mapping, conflict recovery and deletion semantics are unverified.

requirements.salesrabbit: Role controls and enterprise options.
requirements.spotio: Configurable user permissions and report visibility.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: Workspace membership plus user-private customer data enforced for new Sales operations. Enterprise SSO/SSO enforcement not validated.

requirements.salesrabbit: Map overlays, sketching, sales materials and attachments.
requirements.spotio: Custom map colours, KML layers, record photos and links.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: Campaign map, attachments and content surfaces exist; imported KML and custom field colour rules need verification.

requirements.salesrabbit: Team chat and notifications.
requirements.spotio: Chat and notifications.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: Live-session chat/presence exists; broad persistent team messaging equivalence unverified.

requirements.salesrabbit: Training, onboarding, account management, enterprise service options vary by plan.
requirements.spotio: Knowledge base and integration administration documented; contractual service levels need vendor terms.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: Support staffing, migration services, response SLAs and compliance attestations cannot be delivered by a feature toggle.

requirements.salesrabbit: Core and SalesRabbit+ differ; contracts/weather/movers/SSO are not marked at parity in the April 2026 comparison.
requirements.spotio: Capabilities and add-ons depend on account entitlements.
requirements.evidence_or_gap: Target the documented union deliberately; a single demo does not prove every edition/plan behaviour.
